intro: Port City International University publishes a peer-reviewed multidisciplinary journal every year, featuring original and high-quality articles, research reports and case studies covering Humanities, Social Sciences, Business, Science and Technology. The half-yearly journal is published in December and June. Its editorial board comprises eminent Professors from across the country, inviting manuscripts with scholarly debates and innovative thoughts on original research, theoretical papers, literature reviews and short communications.
